prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your desktop is about to get a lot more lively."]
1: ["Sign In to Save Your Desktop Companion", "Link your pet to your main account so it never disappears when switching devices.", "Continue with Primary Account"]
2: ["Select Your Mascot Companion", "Choose a friend that matches your selected personality traits."]
3: ["Launch Your Pet onto Your Desktop", "Complete these quick steps to reveal your new desktop companion.", "1. Keep app active in system tray\n2. Click Summon Pet below", "Summon Pet Now"]
4: ["Choose How to Create Your Desktop Pet", "Select a ready-to-play mascot or generate a custom creation. Both spawn directly onto your desktop in moments.", "Start Setup"]
5: ["Important: Always sign in with the same email to keep your active desktop pet and progress intact."]
6: ["Upload Pet Photos for Desktop Generation", "Provide clear front-facing photos for best rendering on your desktop screen."]
7: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Assets", "We are calibrating animations and desktop overlay permissions. Please hold on.", "Initializing desktop overlay renderer..."]
8: ["We will play a chime when your desktop pet is ready to spawn."]
9: ["Tip: Right-click your pet or use the system tray icon near your desktop clock to control, hide, or interact with your companion."]
